name: browser-profiles
title: Browser Profiles
description: Open links and new windows in a chosen profile of Browser, the profile-first macOS browser, and search its history and bookmarks.
author: bradystroud

commands.name: switch-profile
commands.title: Switch to Profile
commands.subtitle: Browser
commands.description: Focus a profile's window, or open one if it has none.

commands.name: open-link
commands.title: Open Link in Profile
commands.subtitle: Browser
commands.description: Type or paste a URL and open it in a chosen profile, as a new tab or a new window.

commands.name: new-window
commands.title: New Window in Profile
commands.subtitle: Browser
commands.description: Open an empty new window in a chosen profile.

commands.name: open-clipboard-link
commands.title: Open Clipboard Link in Profile
commands.subtitle: Browser
commands.description: Take the URL currently selected or on the clipboard and open it in a chosen profile.

commands.name: search-history
commands.title: Search Browser History
commands.subtitle: Browser
commands.description: Search a profile's browsing history and open a result in any profile.

commands.name: search-bookmarks
commands.title: Search Bookmarks
commands.subtitle: Browser
commands.description: Filter a profile's bookmarks and open one in any profile.

preferences.name: cliPath
preferences.title: Browser CLI Path
preferences.description: Path to the browser CLI. Leave blank to find it inside Browser.app in /Applications or ~/Applications (or at /usr/local/bin/browser if you linked it there).

preferences.name: profilesRoot
preferences.title: Profiles Root
preferences.description: Only for developers targeting a test instance launched with --profiles-root. Leave blank.
